verses.t: “Devo ca vassati, devo ca gaḷagaḷāyati, Ekako cāhaṁ bherave bile viharāmi; Tassa mayhaṁ ekakassa bherave bile viharato, Natthi bhayaṁ vā chambhitattaṁ vā lomahaṁso vā.
Dhammatā mamesā yassa me, Ekakassa bherave bile; Viharato natthi bhayaṁ vā, Chambhitattaṁ vā lomahaṁso vā”ti. … Sambulakaccāno thero ….
